articles.title: Sniff Chocolate, Lift More? Weird New Workout Trick
articles.summary: Scientists found that smelling chocolate before lifting weights helped men do more reps without feeling more tired. Dark chocolate made them feel full, while milk chocolate made the workout more fun. Only 23 men were tested, so experts say more research is needed.

articles.title: Michael Jackson's 3D Space Movie Turns 40: A Disney Secret
articles.summary: Forty years ago, Michael Jackson starred in a 17-minute 3D sci-fi movie called 'Captain EO' that you could only see at Disney parks. It cost nearly $30 million and was made with George Lucas and Francis Ford Coppola. The film used special effects like lasers and fog to surprise audiences.

articles.title: Planes to Drop Rabies Vaccines for Raccoons and Foxes
articles.summary: Next month, the USDA will airdrop millions of rabies vaccine baits across five Southeastern states. The fishmeal-coated packets are for raccoons, coyotes, and foxes. Rabies is fatal but rare in humans, and the vaccine is safe for over 60 species, including pets.
